newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent a lb higher on Wednesday based on market orders at 1018 EDT, traders said.
Tuesday, the December contract ended 0.77 cent higher at 74.24 cents per lb, having ranged from 74.95 to 73.25 cents. The rest of the board finished 0.78 to 0.40 cent higher.
An estimated 20,000 lots changed hands on the day.
Support in December remained at 72.00 cents followed by 70.35 cents, the now-expired July contract low. Resistance was seen at 74.50-75.00 cents.
